=== REFERENCES ===

Use the provided Riven reference for visual continuity.

Use the provided Riven's Broken Sword reference for the weapon.

Use the provided BURNING SETTLEMENT reference
for the present environment.

Use the provided MYSTERIOUS DARK FIGURE reference
only for the strange dark figure.

Riven is in her Two Years Later appearance.

She carries only the HANDLE-SIDE REMAINING HALF
of her Broken Sword.

The missing upper half is completely gone.

The remaining sword is still large and broad,
ending in a rough fractured edge with no pointed tip.

The Broken Sword remains completely dormant.

No rune glow.
No magical energy.


=== TECHNICAL ===

16:9 cinematic live-action dark fantasy.

Grounded photorealistic realism.

Burning settlement at nightfall.

Dense drifting smoke.

Strong orange firelight through the smoke.

Natural fire, wind, ash, footsteps,
burning wood, and environmental sound.

Restrained realistic acting.

Slow controlled cinematic tension.

Natural movement and lip sync.

English dialogue.

No subtitles.

No background music.

No combat in this scene.

Keep the Mysterious Dark Figure partially obscured.

Do not fully reveal its face.

No glowing eyes.

Do not turn it into a normal fantasy monster.

Use only THREE major cinematic shots.


=== VIDEO SUMMARY ===

Riven continues deeper into the burning settlement
after briefly seeing the mysterious figure in the distance.

The road is now almost completely empty.

She hears an unusual sound ahead and stops.

Through the smoke,
the same mysterious dark figure appears again.

This time it is closer.

This time it does not disappear.

Riven and the figure face each other.

Riven recognizes it.

She slowly draws her Broken Sword
and raises it defensively.

Before either side attacks,
an elderly man's desperate cry for help
comes from a nearby burning building.

Riven looks toward the trapped man.

Then she looks back toward the mysterious figure.

She is forced to choose.

CUT before she makes the choice.


=== SHOT 1 — IT RETURNS ===

OPEN on Riven already walking deeper
into the burning settlement.

Use a new over-the-shoulder or three-quarter tracking angle.

Do not recreate the exact ending composition
from the previous moment.

The road is almost completely empty now.

No civilians.

No soldiers.

Only Riven.

Burning wooden buildings stand on both sides.

Smoke drifts slowly across the road.

Ash moves through the orange firelight.

Riven walks carefully forward.

Her attention remains fixed on the darkness ahead.

She is more alert now.

One hand gradually moves closer
to the Broken Sword,
but she does not draw it yet.


Then—

Riven hears a faint,
unnatural sound somewhere ahead.

She immediately stops.

Silence for a brief moment
except for the surrounding fire.

Riven slowly looks forward.


Camera moves behind Riven
and looks down the smoke-filled road.

At first,
only fire and smoke are visible.

Then the smoke begins to shift.


A DARK FIGURE slowly becomes visible ahead.


It is the same mysterious presence
Riven saw before.

But this time it is CLOSER.

Keep a clear physical distance
between Riven and the figure.

Do not place them directly beside each other.

Do not begin combat.


The figure is almost humanoid,
but its proportions feel subtly wrong.

Its shoulders appear slightly too high.

Its arms seem slightly too long.

Its dark silhouette blends unnaturally
into the surrounding smoke.

Orange firelight does not illuminate it normally.

Its face remains completely unclear.

No glowing eyes.

No visible expression.

No detailed monster anatomy.


The figure becomes still.

The smoke moves around it.

But this time—

IT DOES NOT DISAPPEAR.


Riven remains frozen for a moment.

She recognizes it.


=== SHOT 2 — FACE TO FACE ===

Move into a restrained medium close view of Riven.

Firelight flickers across her face.

She stares directly at the mysterious figure.

Her reaction is controlled.

Recognition.

Tension.

Old anger beneath the surface.

But no exaggerated emotion.


Riven quietly says:

"You..."


Cut back toward the mysterious figure.

It does not speak.

It does not attack.

After a short still moment,
the figure makes one very small movement.

It slowly turns or tilts its attention toward Riven.

Keep the movement subtle.

The moment should suggest:

it recognizes Riven too.


Hold the distance between them.

Neither side moves forward.


Riven slowly reaches for the Broken Sword.

She draws it.


IMPORTANT:

This is ONLY the remaining HANDLE-SIDE HALF
of the original sword.

The upper half is completely missing.

Do not restore the blade.

Do not create a complete sword.

Do not create a pointed tip.

The weapon ends at the same large fractured break
shown in the reference.


Riven brings the Broken Sword up
into a controlled defensive position.

The sword remains completely dormant.

No glow.

No rune activation.

No magical effect.


Riven does not charge.

The mysterious figure does not attack.

They simply face each other
through the smoke and fire.

Build the feeling that a confrontation
is about to begin.


Then—


=== SHOT 3 — THE CRY FOR HELP ===

A desperate elderly male voice suddenly breaks the silence
from a nearby burning building:

"Help! Somebody!"


Riven immediately reacts.

She turns her head toward the voice.


Camera follows her attention
toward a nearby damaged wooden building.

Through an open doorway or broken opening,
partially obscured by smoke,

an ELDERLY MAN is visible inside.

He is an ordinary elderly civilian.

Simple worn village clothing.

Gray hair.

No armor.

No weapon.

He is trapped by fallen wooden debris
and cannot get out by himself.

Keep the situation visually simple.

Do not show graphic injuries.

Do not make the moment melodramatic.


The elderly man struggles to move
but cannot free himself.

Smoke continues filling the building.


CUT BACK TO RIVEN.


She looks toward the trapped elderly man.

She still holds the Broken Sword.


Then Riven slowly looks back
toward the mysterious figure.


The figure is STILL THERE.

It remains standing in the smoke.

It has not attacked.

It has not disappeared.


Hold on Riven between these two directions:

THE MYSTERIOUS FIGURE AHEAD.

THE TRAPPED ELDERLY MAN NEARBY.


Do not show Riven making the choice yet.

Do not let her attack the figure.

Do not let the figure attack Riven.

Do not let Riven rescue the elderly man yet.


End on Riven realizing
she cannot pursue both.


CUT.


=== END STATE ===

Riven has encountered the mysterious dark figure
face to face for the first time in the present timeline.

The figure appears to recognize her.

Riven has drawn her Broken Sword,
but no combat has started.

The Broken Sword remains dormant.

An elderly civilian is trapped
inside a nearby burning building
and is calling for help.

Riven has seen him.

The mysterious figure is still present.

Riven must choose between confronting the figure
and helping the trapped man.

CUT.

=== REFERENCES ===

Use the provided Riven reference for visual continuity.

Use the provided Riven weapon reference exactly as shown.

Use the provided Burning Settlement reference
for the current environment.

Use the provided Mysterious Dark Figure reference
only for the dark figure.

Maintain the same burning mountain settlement:
wooden buildings on fire,
heavy dark smoke,
orange firelight,
ash drifting through the air,
and narrow roads running deeper between the buildings.

Keep Riven's weapon visually consistent
with the provided reference throughout the entire video.

Do not redesign or alter the weapon.


=== TECHNICAL ===

16:9 cinematic live-action dark fantasy.

Grounded photorealistic realism.

Burning settlement at nightfall.

Strong orange firelight.

Heavy drifting smoke.

Natural ash and embers in the air.

Natural running movement with realistic speed,
body weight, and momentum.

Dynamic but controlled cinematic camera movement.

Natural footsteps, breathing, fire,
burning wood, wind, and environmental sound.

No dialogue.

No subtitles.

No background music.

No combat yet.

Keep the mysterious figure difficult to see
during the pursuit.

Use only THREE major cinematic shots.


=== VIDEO SUMMARY ===

Riven is looking deeper into the burning settlement
after the mysterious figure has disappeared.

Suddenly,
she hears the same strange sound
from somewhere far deeper inside the village.

Riven immediately recognizes it.

Through the distant smoke,
she briefly sees a dark figure move
across an opening between burning buildings.

Riven reacts instantly.

She breaks into a full-speed sprint
and pursues it deeper into the settlement.

During the chase,
Riven occasionally catches brief glimpses
of the dark figure moving farther ahead through the smoke.

It never remains visible long enough
for her to reach it.

The pursuit leads Riven deeper
into a more isolated part of the burning settlement.

Eventually,
Riven reaches a wider open area.

The dark figure is nowhere to be seen.

Riven slows and searches the smoke.

Then the mysterious figure finally emerges
and stands still ahead of her.

Riven stops.

They face each other.

CUT before combat begins.


=== SHOT 1 — SHE HEARS IT ===

OPEN on Riven looking down
the burning village road.

She is alone.

The mysterious figure is no longer visible.

Do not recreate a long static establishing shot.

Keep the opening brief.

Fire burns throughout the settlement.

Dark smoke moves between the buildings.

Ash drifts through the orange light.

Riven quietly scans the road ahead.


Then—

from somewhere FAR DEEPER inside the settlement,

a faint unnatural sound is heard.


Riven immediately reacts.

Her head turns sharply toward the sound.

She recognizes it.


Camera follows her gaze
far down the burning road.

At first there is only:

fire,

smoke,

burning structures,

and empty space.


Then—

far ahead,

through a temporary opening in the smoke,

a DARK HUMAN-LIKE FIGURE
moves quickly across the road
between two burning structures.


It is only visible for a brief moment.

Do not clearly reveal its face or body.

Do not make it stop and pose.

It crosses the distant opening
and immediately disappears behind smoke and structures.


Riven sees it.


There is almost no hesitation.


She immediately launches forward
into a FULL-SPEED SPRINT.


Her first steps are explosive and urgent.

The camera accelerates with her.

Riven races directly toward
the place where she saw the figure.


=== SHOT 2 — THE PURSUIT ===

Stay close to Riven
as she runs at full speed
deeper into the burning settlement.

Use a dynamic tracking camera.

Alternate naturally between:

close rear tracking,

three-quarter side tracking,

and brief low tracking near her running legs,

without turning the sequence
into many separate disconnected shots.


Riven runs hard.

Her body leans naturally forward.

Her arms drive with her stride.

Her hair and clothing react naturally
to the speed of her movement.

Her breathing becomes stronger.

Keep her weapon secure
and visually consistent with the provided reference.


The environment rushes past her.

Burning wooden buildings line the road.

Smoke moves across her path.

She passes scattered debris.

Firelight flickers rapidly across her
as she moves between structures.


Riven is not running randomly.

She is FOLLOWING the mysterious figure.


Far ahead—

another brief DARK MOVEMENT
appears through the smoke.


The figure crosses another opening.

Riven catches sight of it.

She immediately adjusts her direction
and continues the pursuit.


Keep the mysterious figure
ALWAYS FARTHER AHEAD OF RIVEN.

It never runs beside her.

It never runs behind her.

Riven never catches it during the chase.


Do not show the figure running like a normal human.

Its movement should feel strange and unnaturally fast.

A dark silhouette briefly glides
or rushes through the smoke,

then disappears again behind the environment.


Riven keeps chasing it.


The roads become narrower.

The crowd and civilians are completely gone.

The deeper Riven goes,
the more isolated the environment becomes.


She runs through another thick bank of smoke.

For a moment,
the smoke fills most of the frame.


Riven pushes through it.


=== SHOT 3 — IT STOPS RUNNING ===

Riven emerges from the smoke
into a wider open area
deep inside the burning settlement.

A small crossroads,
open village yard,
or wider section between damaged buildings.

There is more space here.

Burning structures surround the area.

Smoke drifts slowly across the ground
and between the buildings.


Riven continues running forward
for several steps.

But—

the mysterious figure is nowhere to be seen.


Riven quickly slows.

Her sprint becomes a controlled stop.


She looks ahead.

Nothing.


She looks toward one side.

Only smoke and fire.


Then toward the other.

Still nothing.


Keep the tension quiet.

Only Riven's breathing,
the fire,
and the sound of burning wood remain.


Riven becomes completely still.

She watches the smoke.


Then—

ahead of her,

a large section of dark smoke
slowly shifts.


The MYSTERIOUS DARK FIGURE
gradually becomes visible.


This time—

IT IS NOT RUNNING.


It stands motionless
on the opposite side of the open area.


Keep a clear distance between them.


The figure remains almost humanoid,
but subtly unnatural.

Its silhouette is dark.

Its shoulders appear slightly too high.

Its arms appear slightly too long.

Its edges blend unnaturally
into the surrounding smoke.

Orange firelight does not illuminate it normally.

Its face remains unclear.

No glowing eyes.

No clear facial details.


Riven immediately locks her attention onto it.


The figure does not disappear.

It does not move away.

It simply stands there.


Riven understands:

the chase is over.


Slowly,
Riven shifts her posture.

Her breathing begins to settle.

Her hand moves toward her weapon.


Keep the weapon exactly consistent
with the provided reference.


The mysterious figure remains still.


Hold a wider composition:

Riven on one side
of the burning open area.

The mysterious figure
on the opposite side.

Fire and smoke between them.


Neither attacks yet.


Hold the confrontation briefly.


CUT.


=== END STATE ===

Riven heard the mysterious figure
deeper inside the burning settlement.

She saw it briefly
and immediately pursued it at full speed.

The figure led her deeper
through the burning village.

Riven has now reached
a wider isolated area.

The mysterious figure has stopped fleeing.

It stands directly ahead of her.

Riven prepares herself.

No combat has begun yet.

CUT.
